caption: The drawing depicts a single object that appears to be a wooden stamp or mold with a cylindrical handle extending to the left and a round, flat face oriented to the right. The object is rendered in shades of brown, with subtle variations suggesting wood grain and carved details. The round face of the object features a carved symmetrical design with two six-petaled star-like shapes at the top, a central pointed oval, and a large, central, leaf-like or tulip-shaped motif bordered with linear patterns and curved lines radiating outward, as well as other small, carved details. The background of the drawing is plain, off-white, and untextured, with no additional objects or elements present. There is a faint, small inscription in the lower center area that reads, "ROY WEBER."
title: Pa. German Butter Mold
